subject.title: feat: serve signed publisher feed projections

question: Should the established catalog-feed URL retain its current representation while signed publisher feeds are introduced, or may it be intentionally converted to DSSE-only with a coordinated client and signing-secret rollout?
rationale: The patch creates a public response-contract and operational availability change that tests cannot resolve; maintainers must choose the permanent compatibility and rollout policy.

options.title: Preserve the current catalog contract
options.body: Keep the existing catalog representation available and introduce the DSSE form through a new versioned or explicitly negotiated endpoint before merging the publisher routes.

options.title: Approve a DSSE-only migration
options.body: Accept the catalog-route representation replacement only with documented client migration, production secret provisioning, rotation ownership, and live upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause the integration child
options.body: Wait for the prerequisite publisher-state and signing PRs to land separately, then rebase this branch to the narrow public route layer.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current catalog contract
recommendation.body: Keep the existing catalog representation available and introduce the DSSE form through a new versioned or explicitly negotiated endpoint before merging the publisher routes.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review history ties Patrick-Erichsen to the relevant v1 feed-contract concerns.
